Sarasota-Area Museums — February 2027

Updated Friday, November 27, 2026, 7:26 AM ET

Summary

Summary

February is the height of the season, with a big new garden exhibition, two contemporary performances at The Ringling and a full lecture calendar. Here are the standouts:

  • New exhibitions: Selby Gardens opens Verdi: Composer & Farmer, its 2027 Goldstein exhibition on the composer’s life and love of farming (Feb 7, through May 30). The Ringling opens Spectacular Japan (Feb 20). The Bishop’s Smithsonian show X-Ray Vision: Fish Inside Out is on view all month, and Keith Haring: Lines in Motion continues at Ringling College.
  • Talks and lectures: The Ringling’s Viewpoint Lecture with Michelle Liu Carriger (Feb 19) and two gallery talks (Feb 2 and 16). Mote’s Mote-ivational lectures (Feb 8 and 25, at City Island). SAM’s Quotable Talk with Ara H. Merjian (Feb 20) and Art at Noon (Feb 16). The Historical Society’s Conversation at The Crocker on Whitfield Estates (Feb 28) and the Venice Art Center’s Baila Miller lecture on Brady vs Gardner (Feb 2).
  • Festivals and big nights: Selby’s Orchid Ball gala (Feb 6). An extra public day of Crowley’s Myakka River Rendezvous (Feb 6). Ringling Underground (Feb 4). Art Center Sarasota’s live art battle Art Royale (Feb 13). Sales: the Herrig Center’s Spring Pottery Sale (Feb 6) and the Historical Society’s Sparkly Saturday (Feb 13). Mote’s Breakfast with the Sharks (Feb 27).
  • Music, film and theater: Agrupación Señor Serrano’s Birdie (Feb 10–11) and LaMichael Leonard Jr.’s SKIN NOISE (Feb 24–26) at The Ringling. National Theatre Live: Les Liaisons Dangereuses (Feb 18–19). Ringling by the Bay (Feb 1 and 15) and Jazz Sunsets (Feb 23). At SAM, Uncorked (Feb 9) and Art on Film (Feb 23).
  • Last chances: The Venice Art Center’s All Around Town ends Feb 10. Art Center Sarasota’s four current shows close Feb 27. The Ringling’s Seba Calfuqueo: TRAY TRAY KO closes Feb 28.
  • For kids: Selby has Sensory Saturdays (Feb 13), Tranquil Tuesdays (Feb 9), the Little Sprouts Club (Feb 11 and 19) and Family Saturday (Feb 27). The Bishop has Backyard Science every Saturday, KidSpace on Feb 6 and a Homeschool Thursday on Feb 11. Mote has Shark Pups & Grown Ups (Feb 6 and 20). SAM’s Free Second Sunday falls on Valentine’s Day.

No museum posts a Valentine’s Day event. On Presidents’ Day (Mon Feb 15), The Ringling, SAM, both Selby campuses, Jungle Gardens and De Soto keep regular hours, and The Bishop is closed as on every Monday. Check before visiting Manatee Village that day. See holiday notes for details. The Florida Maritime Museum stays closed all month.

Holiday closures & changed hours

Taken from each museum’s official hours page. “Not posted” means the site gives regular hours but says nothing about the holiday, so call ahead.

Presidents’ Day, Mon, Feb 15

  • Closed for the holiday: none posted
  • Open (regular hours): The Ringling, Sarasota Art Museum, Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Downtown Sarasota, Marie Selby Botanical Gardens — Historic Spanish Point, Sarasota Jungle Gardens, De Soto National Memorial
  • Closed Mondays as usual: The Bishop Museum of Science and Nature, Anna Maria Island Historical Museum, Marietta Museum of Art & Whimsy, Palmetto Historical Park, Venice Museum & Archives (Venice History Museum), Crowley Museum & Nature Center
  • Check before going: Manatee Village Historical Park — the Manatee County Clerk, which runs it, lists Presidents’ Day as a closed day in its 2027 holiday schedule, but the park’s own page says nothing.
  • Normally open that day, but no holiday hours posted: Art Center Sarasota, Gamble Plantation Historic State Park, Herrig Center for the Arts, The Ringling, Venice Art Center

Valentine’s Day, Sun, Feb 14

  • No museum on this page posts a Valentine’s Day event or changed hours. It falls on the second Sunday, so Sarasota Art Museum is free (11 AM–5 PM), and The Ringling’s Bayfront Gardens Tour runs at 11 AM.

Other February closures and changes

  • Venice Art Center: All Around Town and Mary Adcock-Ingram close Wed Feb 10. No February show after that is posted yet.
  • Art Center Sarasota: the four current shows close Sat Feb 27; the next shows open Mar 11.
  • The Ringling: Seba Calfuqueo: TRAY TRAY KO closes Feb 28. Spectacular Japan opens Feb 20.
  • Selby Gardens: The Orchid Ball fills the Downtown campus on the evening of Sat Feb 6; Verdi: Composer & Farmer opens the next day.
  • The Bishop: closed Mondays. Crowley: open weekends only. Marietta Museum: Thu–Sat only.
  • Florida Maritime Museum: closed all month for building rehabilitation.
